paragraphs.gd: Is mise Mairi. Tha mi a' fuireach ann an Glaschu. Anns a' mhadainn, tha mi ag ithe briosgaidean agus ag òl tì.
paragraphs.en: I am Mairi. I live in Glasgow. In the morning, I eat biscuits and drink tea.

paragraphs.gd: An-dèidh sin, tha mi a' falbh dhan sgoil. Tha mo charaid, Iain, a' fuireach faisg air an sgoil.
paragraphs.en: After that, I go to school. My friend, Iain, lives near the school.

paragraphs.gd: Feasgar, tha sinn a' coimhead film còmhla. Tha e gu math toilichte.
paragraphs.en: In the evening, we watch a film together. He is very happy.

paragraphs.gd: Tha taigh beag agam. Tha e dearg agus geal. Anns an taigh, tha cù dubh agus cat buidhe.
paragraphs.en: I have a small house. It is red and white. In the house, there is a black dog and a yellow cat.

paragraphs.gd: Tha mo theaghlach a' fuireach còmhla rium: mo mhàthair, m' athair, agus mo phiuthar.
paragraphs.en: My family lives with me: my mother, my father, and my sister.

paragraphs.gd: An-uiridh, chaidh mi air turas gun Eilean Sgitheanach le mo theaghlach. Ghabh sinn an trèana gu Inbhir Nis, agus an uair sin am bus.
paragraphs.en: Last year, I went on a trip to the Isle of Skye with my family. We took the train to Inverness, and then the bus.

paragraphs.gd: Bha an t-sìde fuar ach grianach. Choisich sinn anns na beanntan agus thog sinn mòran dhealbhan.
paragraphs.en: The weather was cold but sunny. We walked in the mountains and took many photos.

paragraphs.gd: Is toil leam a bhith a' siubhal, gu h-àraidh nuair a tha an t-sìde math. B' e turas air leth a bh' ann.
paragraphs.en: I like traveling, especially when the weather is good. It was a wonderful trip.

paragraphs.gd: Tha mi ag obair ann an oifis mhòr ann an Dùn Èideann. Ged a tha an obair inntinneach, tha i uaireannan duilich leis cho trang 's a tha i.
paragraphs.en: I work in a big office in Edinburgh. Although the work is interesting, it is sometimes difficult because of how busy it is.

paragraphs.gd: Nam biodh barrachd ùine agam, dh'ionnsaichinn barrachd Gàidhlig agus bhithinn a' leughadh tuilleadh leabhraichean.
paragraphs.en: If I had more time, I would learn more Gaelic and I would read more books.

paragraphs.gd: Thuirt mo cho-obraiche gun robh i airson atharrachadh a dhèanamh air a cosnadh am bliadhna, oir bha i a' faireachdainn gun robh dùbhlain ùra a dhìth oirre.
paragraphs.en: My colleague said that she wanted to make a change to her job this year, because she felt that she needed new challenges.

paragraphs.gd: Anns a' mhadainn, tha mi a' cur orm m' aodach: lèine, briogais, agus bròg. Tha e fuar, mar sin cuiridh mi orm còta cuideachd.
paragraphs.en: In the morning, I put on my clothes: a shirt, trousers, and shoes. It's cold, so I put on a coat too.

paragraphs.gd: Tha mo cheann goirt an-diugh, ach tha mi a' dol dhan sgoil co-dhiù. Tha mo charaid a' feitheamh orm aig an doras.
paragraphs.en: My head is sore today, but I'm going to school anyway. My friend is waiting for me at the door.

paragraphs.gd: Bha mi anns a' mhargaid an-diugh a' ceannach bìdh. Bha an t-sìde fliuch agus gaothach, ach bha mi airson poca ùbhlan fhaighinn.
paragraphs.en: I was at the market today buying food. The weather was wet and windy, but I wanted to get a bag of apples.

paragraphs.gd: Dh'fhaighnich mi don neach-reic cia mheud a bha na h-ùbhlan a' cosg. Bha iad saor, mar sin cheannaich mi barrachd na bha dùil agam.
paragraphs.en: I asked the seller how much the apples cost. They were cheap, so I bought more than I expected.

paragraphs.gd: Air an rathad dhachaigh, thòisich an t-uisge, agus ruith mi dhan stèisean a' chabhag.
paragraphs.en: On the way home, the rain started, and I ran to the station in a hurry.

paragraphs.gd: Tha mo nàbaidh, Ealasaid, a' fuireach ann am baile beag air a' Ghàidhealtachd fad a beatha. Tha i fìor eòlach air cultar agus traidiseanan an àite, agus bidh i a' seinn ann an seann nòs aig an fhèis ionadail gach bliadhna.
paragraphs.en: My neighbour, Ealasaid, has lived in a small town in the Highlands her whole life. She's very knowledgeable about the area's culture and traditions, and she sings in the old style at the local festival every year.

paragraphs.gd: Ged a tha i aosta a-nis, cha toil leatha fòn-làimhe no meadhanan sòisealta idir — is fheàrr leatha a bhith a' bruidhinn ri daoine aghaidh ri aghaidh anns a' bhùth bheag ionadail.
paragraphs.en: Although she is elderly now, she doesn't like mobile phones or social media at all — she prefers talking to people face to face in the small local shop.

paragraphs.gd: Bidh mi fhìn ag ionnsachadh mòran bhuaipe mu dheidhinn beul-aithris an àite, rudan nach fhaighear ann an leabhraichean idir.
paragraphs.en: I myself learn a lot from her about the area's oral tradition, things you won't find in any books at all.

paragraphs.gd: Thathar ag ràdh gu bheil an eadar-lìon air buaidh mhòr a thoirt air coimhearsnachdan dùthchail, gu h-àraidh a thaobh a bhith a' cumail cànan agus cultar beò am measg nan òigridh.
paragraphs.en: It is being said that the internet has had a big effect on rural communities, especially regarding keeping language and culture alive among young people.

paragraphs.gd: A rèir choltais, tha barrachd dhaoine òga a' cleachdadh meadhanan sòisealta gus Gàidhlig ionnsachadh seach a bhith an urra ri clasaichean a-mhàin, rud a tha a' togail connspaid am measg feadhainn a tha a' cumail a-mach gu bheil seo a' lagachadh dòighean traidiseanta ionnsachaidh.
paragraphs.en: Apparently, more young people are using social media to learn Gaelic rather than relying on classes alone, which raises controversy among those who maintain that this weakens traditional learning methods.

paragraphs.gd: Air an làimh eile, 's dòcha gur e seo dìreach aon adhbhar a bharrachd a chum a' chànain beò aig a' cheann thall, ge bith dè an dòigh a thèid a cleachdadh.
paragraphs.en: On the other hand, this may simply be one more reason that keeps the language alive in the end, whatever method is used.

paragraphs.gd: An-diugh, tha mi tinn. Tha mo cheann goirt agus tha mi sgìth. Chan eil mi a' dol dhan sgoil.
paragraphs.en: Today, I am ill. My head is sore and I am tired. I am not going to school.

paragraphs.gd: Thug mo mhàthair cungaidh-leigheis dhomh, agus bha mi nam laighe fad an latha.
paragraphs.en: My mother gave me medicine, and I lay down all day.

paragraphs.gd: A-màireach, bidh mi nas fheàrr, tha mi an dòchas!
paragraphs.en: Tomorrow, I will be better, I hope!

paragraphs.gd: Dh'fhalbh sinn sa mhadainn tràth air bus, le ar bagaichean is tiogaidean nar làmhan. Bha an speur gorm agus grianach.
paragraphs.en: We left early in the morning by bus, with our bags and tickets in our hands. The sky was blue and sunny.

paragraphs.gd: Air an rathad, chunnaic sinn bàtaichean aig a' phort agus itealan a' falbh dhan adhar.
paragraphs.en: On the road, we saw boats at the port and a plane taking off into the sky.

paragraphs.gd: Nuair a ràinig sinn an stèisean, bha an t-sìde air atharrachadh gu tur: ceò is tàirneanach! Ruith sinn dhan taigh-òsta.
paragraphs.en: When we reached the station, the weather had completely changed: fog and thunder! We ran to the hotel.

paragraphs.gd: An ath-mhìos, bidh sinn a' gluasad taigh gu àite-còmhnaidh ùr faisg air a' bhaile. Tha mi fo iomagain beagan, ach tha mi cuideachd moiteil gun do rinn sinn an co-dhùnadh seo.
paragraphs.en: Next month, we are moving house to a new dwelling near the town. I'm a little anxious, but I'm also proud that we made this decision.

paragraphs.gd: Bidh seòmar-cadail agam fhìn, agus gàrradh beag far an urrainn dhomh fois a ghabhail feasgar.
paragraphs.en: I'll have my own bedroom, and a small garden where I can rest in the evening.

paragraphs.gd: Chunnaic sinn aithris mun bhaile air na naidheachdan an-dè — thuirt an neach-naidheachd gu bheil a' choimhearsnachd a' fàs gu math luath.
paragraphs.en: We saw a report about the town on the news yesterday — the journalist said that the community is growing quite quickly.

paragraphs.gd: Chaidh agallamh fhoillseachadh an-dè anns am biodh ministear a' bruidhinn mu chùrsa-slàinte na dùthcha. A rèir choltais, tha am pàipear-naidheachd air aithris a sgrìobhadh a tha, gu ìre mhòr, eadar-dhealaichte bhon agallamh fhèin.
paragraphs.en: An interview was published yesterday in which a minister spoke about the country's healthcare system. Apparently, the newspaper has written a report that is, to a large extent, different from the interview itself.

paragraphs.gd: Tha cuid a' cumail a-mach gu bheil a' chraoladh fhèin cothromach, ach gu bheil na sanasan-naidheachd a' cur cuideam air pàirtean sònraichte seach am fìor sgeulachd.
paragraphs.en: Some maintain that the broadcast itself is balanced, but that the news headlines emphasise certain parts rather than the real story.

paragraphs.gd: Aig a' cheann thall, is e an fhianais fhèin as fheàrr airson breithneachadh a dhèanamh, seach a bhith an urra ri aon tùs a-mhàin.
paragraphs.en: Ultimately, the evidence itself is the best thing for making a judgement, rather than relying on a single source alone.

paragraphs.gd: Halò, is mise Anna. Seo mo bhràthair, Dòmhnall, agus mo phiuthar, Catrìona. Tha sinn uile a' fuireach còmhla ri ar pàrantan.
paragraphs.en: Hello, I'm Anna. This is my brother, Donald, and my sister, Catherine. We all live together with our parents.

paragraphs.gd: Mas e do thoil e, an urrainn dhut Beurla a bhruidhinn? Tha beagan Beurla agam, ach is fheàrr leam Gàidhlig.
paragraphs.en: Please, can you speak English? I have a little English, but I prefer Gaelic.

paragraphs.gd: Mo chreach, tha thu a' bruidhinn Gàidhlig glè mhath! Cò às a tha thu?
paragraphs.en: My goodness, you speak Gaelic very well! Where are you from?

paragraphs.gd: Thathar ag ràdh gu bheil an riaghaltas gu bhith a' foillseachadh poileasaidh ùr a thaobh na h-àrainneachd an ath-mhìos. A rèir choltais, bidh seo a' toirt buaidh mhòr air gnìomhachasan air feadh na dùthcha.
paragraphs.en: It is being said that the government is going to publish a new environmental policy next month. Apparently, this will have a major effect on businesses across the country.

paragraphs.gd: Air an làimh eile, tha cuid a' cumail a-mach gu bheil am buileachadh ro mhall, agus gu bheil feum air gnìomh nas luaithe a thaobh atharrachadh na gnàth-shìde.
paragraphs.en: On the other hand, some maintain that the implementation is too slow, and that faster action is needed regarding climate change.

paragraphs.gd: Aig a' cheann thall, 's dòcha gur e fianais eacanomach agus sòisealta còmhla a bheir buaidh air a' cho-dhùnadh mu dheireadh, seach argamaidean poilitigeach a-mhàin.
paragraphs.en: Ultimately, it may be economic and social evidence together that influences the final decision, rather than political arguments alone.
